primary_on_target_case.citation: Zhou et al., OncoTargets and Therapy 2021;14:2847-2851

timeline_months.progression_event: Right lower lung consolidation and pleural effusion
Enlarged right lung mass, right lobe atelectasis, increased pleural effusion

timeline_months.regimen: Osimertinib 80 mg QD + Gefitinib 250 mg QD
timeline_months.progression_event: Allelic shift from T790M-trans-C797S to T790M-cis-C797S

timeline_months.regimen: Osimertinib 80 mg QD + Anlotinib 12 mg QD + Pemetrexed/Cisplatin induction
timeline_months.progression_event: Emergence of concomitant cis and trans C797S subclones

histology.subtype: Invasive lung adenocarcinoma with malignant pleural effusion

combination_regimens.name: Osimertinib + Savolitinib
combination_regimens.rationale: Overcomes MET amplification bypass by dual blockade of mutant EGFR and MET-driven ERBB3 trans-phosphorylation.

combination_regimens.name: Amivantamab + Lazertinib
combination_regimens.rationale: Bispecific extracellular EGFR/MET antibody + CNS-penetrant 3rd-Gen TKI; superior PFS and OS vs Osimertinib monotherapy.

combination_regimens.name: BLU-945 Monotherapy
combination_regimens.rationale: Mutant-selective reversible ATP competitor specifically designed to bind the triple-mutant L858R/T790M/C797S active site.

critic_guidance_rules.trigger: Plasma ctDNA NGS is negative for MET amplification at Osimertinib progression
critic_guidance_rules.action: Never rule out MET bypass from ctDNA alone. Require tissue re-biopsy with central MET IHC (cutoff >=90% 3+) or FISH.
Mandate prophylactic oral anticoagulation during the first 4 months to prevent VTE events.
Verify read-level phasing. If C797S is in cis with T790M, reject Gefitinib + Osimertinib (CI > 1.1) and route to 4th-Gen BLU-945.

critic_guidance_rules.trigger: High tumor PD-L1 expression (TPS >= 80%) in EGFR-mutant progression
critic_guidance_rules.action: Block single-agent anti-PD-1/PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitors with Osimertinib due to severe fatal pneumonitis/ILD risk.
